text:
noah: Morning — I'm day 1 and running into a couple security/setup questions. Laptop arrived but I hit a snag enrolling my YubiKey and the VPN profile. Who should I ping for the sequence? :wave:

it-ops: hey @noah — welcome! For YubiKey we usually do a quick enrollment with Device Ops. Steps: enroll in SSO (Okta) -> add 2FA method -> register YubiKey. Did you see the 'Finish device setup' card in the Okta dashboard?

noah: I see the Okta card but when I plug the key it doesn't register. macOS 13.6.1, M1 MBP. I tried the command they sent, `pkcs11-tool --list-objects`, got a permission error.

maria: @noah did you complete FileVault and MDM enrollment first? YubiKey enrollment requires the MDM profile to be present (we set a small cert profile). Can you run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output?

noah: I haven't enabled FileVault yet. Is that required day-1? I can run `sudo fdesetup status` but want to avoid breaking anything.

sam: FileVault is required per policy, but IT can help if it's blocking. If you post the `fdesetup` output we'll advise. Also, if your YubiKey is NFC-only we need a USB-C adapter.

noah: output: "FileVault is On." Okta still says 2FA incomplete. When I try to register the security key it times out.

it-ops: hmm. Try replugging with a different port and disable any local password managers. Also check System Preferences -> Security -> External Accessories (some Macs block USB devices initially). If that fails we'll whip up a support ticket and escalate to hardware.

noah: thanks. Second question: I have a conflict with the mandatory phishing-sim training window — I'm traveling Wed-Fri next week and can't access work wifi. Can I get an extension or an alternate way to complete?

security: @noah — short answer: yes. We can grant a one-week extension or mark it as remote-complete. Please DM people-ops with travel dates and we'll note the exemption. Note: exemption doesn't opt you out of follow-up micro-sims; those are rolling.

people-ops: @noah — please file a quick travel exception in the onboarding checklist (link below) and attach your return date. We'll coordinate with Security to adjust deadlines. https://intra.redwood/workflows/onboard-exception

okta-bot: Okta: SSO enrollment completed for noah (device fingerprint matched).

noah: ok I replugged, tried different ports, re-ran `profiles status -type enrollment` and it shows MDM enrolled. Still timing out when registering key. I'll open a ticket.

it-ops: go ahead — if you include the error message and the output of `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` we'll try a remote session. If you prefer we can arrange a drop-in at HQ for physical troubleshooting next week.

maria: also FYI — if we can't register the YubiKey today we can register platform TOTP as a backup so you can get to everything. We'll help migrate to the key later.

noah: perfect — opening ticket now with logs. Really appreciate the quick help and the extension option. :pray:

people-ops: welcome again! ping us if you need badge or lab access after the ticket. We'll loop Security on the phishsim timeline once travel exception is added.

security: tagging for visibility — we'll follow up on the micro-sim schedule and confirm the training extension in the ticket. :lock:
